blocks.text: "I will start investing when I earn more." — The most expensive lie.

items: Start at 25: You invest ₹18 Lakhs -> You get about ₹1.75 crore, not guaranteed.
Start at 35: You invest ₹12 Lakhs -> You get about ₹49 lakh, not guaranteed.

blocks.text: With these assumptions, starting ten years later gives a smaller projected corpus. The difference is an illustration, not a guaranteed loss.

sections.heading: Illustration (₹5,000 monthly SIP, assumed 12% annual return, monthly compounding; actual returns vary)

summary: An illustrative comparison of two monthly SIP timelines. See how contribution duration and an assumed return affect a projected corpus. Actual returns vary.
title: SIP Power
